habitat_description: Wide ride habitat flanked by secondary woodland aged 15 years- composition is mixed broadleaves including oak, willow sp. ash, cherry, birch, hornbeam, Guelder rose, wild service, elder, blackthorn. crab apple, hawthorn, dogwood, amongst other species. Tall herbs line areas of the wide ride including broom and a range of flora is establishing along the ride edge. A historic agricultural drainage runs west to east, lined with more mature willow including almond willow, oak and other broadleaves. It sits in close proximity to managed grassland where arisings are cut and collected during September annually. The wide ride habitat along the transect is also cut in September in a piecemeal fashion (zone 1 sections cut on a 3-5 year rotation with pinch points left) and arisings are collected. Zone 2 and 3 areas are cut on a longer rotation, and some coppiced edges are being incorporated to support a more diverse habitat structure. The site sits on London Clay soils and can become waterlogged. The grassland is predominantly neutral becoming slightly more acidic towards the southern end. The whole area is publically accessible and forms part of the managed ride network- cut three times annually.

habitat_description: Wide ride habitat flanked by secondary woodland aged 15 years- composition is mixed broadleaves including oak, willow sp. ash, cherry, birch, hornbeam, Guelder rose, wild service, elder, blackthorn. crab apple, hawthorn, dogwood, amongst other species. Tall herbs line areas of the wide ride including broom and a range of flora is establishing along the ride edge. A historic agricultural drainage runs west to east, lined with more mature willow including almond willow, oak and other broadleaves. It sits in close proximity to managed grassland where arisings are cut and collected during September annually. The wide ride habitat along the transect is also cut in September in a piecemeal fashion (zone 1 sections cut on a 3-5 year rotation with pinch points left) and arisings are collected. Zone 2 and 3 areas are cut on a longer rotation, and some coppiced edges are being incorporated to support a more diverse habitat structure. The site sits on London Clay soils and can become waterlogged. The grassland is predominantly neutral becoming slightly more acidic towards the southern end. The whole area is publically accessible and forms part of the managed ride network- cut three times annually.

habitat_description: Wide ride habitat flanked by secondary woodland aged 15 years- composition is mixed broadleaves including oak, willow sp. ash, cherry, birch, hornbeam, Guelder rose, wild service, elder, blackthorn. crab apple, hawthorn, dogwood, amongst other species. Tall herbs line areas of the wide ride including broom and a range of flora is establishing along the ride edge. A historic agricultural drainage runs west to east, lined with more mature willow including almond willow, oak and other broadleaves. It sits in close proximity to managed grassland where arisings are cut and collected during September annually. The wide ride habitat along the transect is also cut in September in a piecemeal fashion (zone 1 sections cut on a 3-5 year rotation with pinch points left) and arisings are collected. Zone 2 and 3 areas are cut on a longer rotation, and some coppiced edges are being incorporated to support a more diverse habitat structure. The site sits on London Clay soils and can become waterlogged. The grassland is predominantly neutral becoming slightly more acidic towards the southern end. The whole area is publically accessible and forms part of the managed ride network- cut three times annually.
